description: Read or write billing preferences (auto-reload, budget cap, default context). Pass action: "get" to read, action: "set" with fields to write.

action.description: "get" to read preferences, "set" to update them.

auto_reload_amount.description: Amount (USD) to reload when triggered (set only, max 500).

auto_reload_threshold.description: Balance threshold (USD) that triggers a reload (set only).

budget_limit.description: Monthly spending cap in USD, or null to remove (set only).

default_billing_context.description: Default account to bill (set only). "personal" or "team:<id>".

name: account_preferences
title: Account Preferences
